study: Cross-Project Heterogeneity in Quality-Oriented Engineering Change
finding: The pooled maintenance-intent mix masks material project-to-project differences. In the primary 43-project subset with at least 20 manually labeled commits, chi-square(84)=432.452, p≈2.46e-48 and Cramer's V=0.302. The effect remains close to 0.30 under increasingly strict project-size thresholds. Phoenix, PDFBox, Commons Math, Commons Lang, and Tez are among the largest project-level contributors to the omnibus heterogeneity.
source: Trautsch et al. manually classified Apache commit-intent dataset, Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.7078179
interpretation_boundary: Descriptive and inferential cross-project maintenance-intent analysis. The release does not rank project quality, identify causal project effects, estimate engineering-change cost or schedule impact, or model temporal dynamics.
